content: The TCT 2009 schedule outlines the coordination of TV events at the Moscone Convention Center, specifically in Room East 264. Below are the detailed descriptions of the interviews and trials scheduled for the event: Tuesday, September 22, 2009 12:30 PM 1:00 PM: Interview with Peter Smits discussing the COMPARE trial, a prospective, randomized study comparing everolimus-eluting stents to paclitaxel-eluting stents. The embargo on this data lifts on Wednesday, September 23, at 12:30 PM. 1:00 PM 1:30 PM: Interview with Shamir Mehta about the CURRENT-PCI OASIS 7 trial, a prospective, randomized, placebo-controlled study evaluating high-dose versus standard-dose clopidogrel and highversus standard-dose aspirin in patients undergoing PCI. The embargo lifts on Thursday, September 24, at 5:25 PM. 5:00 PM 5:30 PM: Interview with Francesco Prati regarding the COCKTAIL trial, a prospective, randomized study of intracoronary abciximab infusion in patients with thrombotic lesions assessed by OCT. The embargo lifts on Thursday, September 24, at 4:05 PM. Wednesday, September 23, 2009 8:30 AM 9:00 AM: Interview with William Fearon about the FAME trial, a 2-year follow-up of a prospective, randomized study comparing FFR-guided PCI to angiography-guided PCI in patients with multivessel coronary artery disease. 9:00 AM 9:30 AM: Interview with Josef Veselka discussing the STATINS PRE-PCI trial, a prospective, randomized study evaluating the use of statins prior to stent implantation in patients with stable angina. 10:00 AM 10:30 AM: Interview with Deepak Bhatt covering two trials: 1. COGENT, a prospective, randomized, placebo-controlled study of omeprazole in patients receiving aspirin and clopidogrel. 2. CHARISMA Genomics Substudy, evaluating the CYP2C19 polymorphism in a randomized trial of chronic clopidogrel use for primary and secondary prevention. 10:15 AM 10:30 AM: Interview with Douglas Losordo about the ACT 34-CMI trial. 10:30 AM 11:00 AM: Interview with David Cohen on the TRITON-TIMI 38 Economic Substudy, which examines the cost-effectiveness of prasugrel versus clopidogrel in ACS patients undergoing PCI. 11:00 AM 11:30 AM: Interview with Michelle O'Donoghue discussing the risk of cardiovascular events in patients treated with clopidogrel or prasugrel in combination with a proton pump inhibitor, based on results from the TRITON-TIMI 38 trial. 12:00 PM 12:30 PM: Interview with Robert Byrne about the ISAR-DESIRE 2 trial, a prospective, randomized study comparing paclitaxel-eluting stents to sirolimus-eluting stents for treating restenosis in sirolimus-eluting stents. 1:00 PM 1:30 PM: Interview with Sunil Rao on radial artery procedures (not a trial). 1:30 PM 2:00 PM: Interview with Stephan Windecker regarding the SIRTAX-LATE trial, a 5-year clinical and randomized study of sirolimus-eluting and paclitaxel-eluting stents. 3:45 PM 4:00 PM: Interview with Christopher Cannon about the PLATO Invasive trial, a prospective, randomized, placebo-controlled study of ticagrelor versus clopidogrel in ACS patients managed with an invasive strategy. Thursday, September 24, 2009 12:45 PM 1:15 PM: Interview with Cheol Whan Lee discussing two trials: 1. ZEST, a large-scale randomized trial comparing zotarolimus-eluting, sirolimus-eluting, and paclitaxel-eluting stents. 2. CILOTAX, a prospective, randomized, controlled trial of a stent eluting cilostazol and paclitaxel. 1:15 PM 1:45 PM: Interview with Flavio Ribichini about the CEREA-DES trial, a prospective, randomized study of corticosteroids in patients undergoing stent implantation. 2:45 PM 3:15 PM: Interview with Junbo Ge on the NO REFLOW trial, a prospective, randomized study comparing intracoronary versus guide catheter infusion of nitrates versus calcium channel blockers in patients with no reflow after primary PCI in STEMI. 3:15 PM 3:45 PM: Interview with Giulio Guagliumi regarding the OCTAMI trial, a prospective, randomized study of zotarolimus-eluting and bare-metal stents in STEMI assessed by OCT. 3:45 PM 4:15 PM: Interview with Josep Rodes-Cabau about the Canadian Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation Program, which includes acute and late follow-up from a multicenter consecutive series of patients with inoperable or high-surgical-risk aortic stenosis. 5:15 PM 5:45 PM: Interview with Ran Kornowski on the evolving landscape of interventional cardiology. 5:45 PM 6:00 PM: Interview with Patrick Ohlmann about the MISTRAL trial, a prospective, randomized study of ambulance-initiated versus cath lab-initiated intravenous abciximab in STEMI patients. 6:00 PM 6:30 PM: Interview with John Spertus on the NEVO RES-ELUTION trial. Friday, September 25, 2009 8:30 AM 9:00 AM: Interview with Dirk Walter about the PROVASA trial, a prospective, randomized, placebo-controlled study of intra-arterial progenitor cell transplantation of bone marrow mononuclear cells in patients with peripheral arterial occlusive disease. 9:00 AM 9:30 AM: Interview with Volker Klauss discussing the LEADERS trial, a 2-year follow-up of a prospective, randomized study comparing biolimus A9-eluting stents with a bioabsorbable polymer to sirolimus-eluting stents with a durable polymer. 10:30 AM 11:00 AM: Interview with Simon Redwood about the BCIS-1 trial, a prospective, randomized study of intra-aortic balloon pump counterpulsation in high-risk patients undergoing PCI. 11:00 AM 11:30 AM: Interview with Arnold Seto on the FAUST trial, a prospective, randomized study comparing ultrasound-guided versus standard femoral arterial access. 12:30 PM 1:00 PM: Interview with Rolf Michels regarding the DEBATER trial, a prospective, randomized study of drug-eluting versus bare-metal stents with or without abciximab in STEMI. 1:00 PM 1:30 PM: Interview with Gregg Stone covering three trials: 1. SPIRIT IV, a prospective, randomized study comparing everolimus-eluting stents to paclitaxel-eluting stents. 2. PROSPECT, a natural history study of atherosclerosis using multimodality intracoronary imaging to identify vulnerable plaque. 3. HORIZONS-AMI, a 2-year follow-up of a prospective, randomized study comparing heparin plus glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors to bivalirudin and paclitaxel-eluting versus bare-metal stents in STEMI. 1:30 PM 2:00 PM: Interview with Henry Krum about the SYMPLICITY I trial.
